content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The automated delivery pipeline for digital products follows a specific sequence that eliminates every manual step. A buyer visits the storefront, selects a product, and initiates payment. The checkout displays a QR code with the exact wallet address and payment amount in their chosen cryptocurrency, converted from USD at the current exchange rate via live price feeds. The buyer sends the payment from their wallet. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain and detects the incoming transaction within seconds of broadcast. When the transaction receives sufficient confirmations on-chain, NOWPayments fires a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the payment amount, confirms the transaction hash on the blockchain directly, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the download link to the buyer's email address.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your payment infrastructure, you will need a few essential tools: a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic processor such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. You will also need a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets to manage orders and Google Drive for file delivery. Ensure you have everything prepared before you begin the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by hosting your website on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, enabling you to process transactions automatically. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency payment processing, ensuring that your customers can pay in Bitcoin or other cryptocurrencies. Set up Supabase or Google Sheets to manage and track your ebook orders, and automate delivery through Google Drive to ensure customers receive their products instantly after payment.
Retain more revenue by minimizing transaction fees with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is configured, it’s time to go live. Announce your ebook availability through your marketing channels and direct customers to your online store. Monitor your payment processing through NOWPayments to ensure that transactions are confirmed on-chain before delivering the product. Test the entire purchasing process from start to finish to iron out any issues. Once you successfully process your first transaction, you'll confirm that your setup is operational and ready for scaling.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing a solid foundation, you can focus on scaling your operations. Start by analyzing your sales data to identify popular products and optimize your offerings. You can add more digital products, such as courses or templates, leveraging your existing infrastructure. Additionally, consider marketing strategies such as social media promotions or email campaigns to drive traffic to your site. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all the necessary blueprints and templates to expand your digital commerce stack efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Your customers will appreciate instant delivery of digital products.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell ebooks and other digital products without the restrictions of traditional platforms, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It contains everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack successfully.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
